architectureNotes: The add-mean completion report and the breakdown's Plan Maintenance entry both say the 4 unfixed Minor review findings are recorded in this ledger (wave 1), but the file is not in main (`git ls-tree -r main` has no stats-signals path). Those findings are not recorded anywhere in the repository.

add-mean read the obligation and the brief's 'each function is tested, including its error case' as not applying to `sum`, because `sum` is defined on the empty array (src/stats.js:3-8 returns 0) and Errors only covers functions undefined on their input. This is consistent with the document and no decision moves. Later units should apply the same reading: functions that are defined on all inputs get no invented error test.

`mean` does not validate elements (add-mean-plan Design 3), so non-finite input, e.g. mean([Infinity, -Infinity]), returns NaN. The Module domain is 'arrays of finite numbers', so this does not break 'never returns NaN'. Still, the document does not say whether input outside the domain is the caller's responsibility or should be validated. Later functions will meet the same question.
